snapshot.text: Mixed public-private system with federal, provincial and local governments sharing responsibility since 2015. A new health minister, a doctor, took office in 2026 facing a daunting task of revamping the sector.

priorities.title: Revamping the health sector
priorities.text: The new minister faces reform of a health sector with weak services and governance.

priorities.title: WHO support
priorities.text: WHO says it is ready to support Nepal's health plans.
